answer: Each identity carries a horizon of twelve epochs: its spending cap equals only peer-attested work inside it, so a fresh sybil starts at zero and cannot buy history. Keeping it open costs 2,500 POA per epoch; a missed payment resets the cap. Forged work zeroes the whole horizon and bans the identity for twelve epochs; a violet flag freezes payouts during review. The network reads each identity's pulse: 1,000 fakes pay 30,000,000 POA to fake twelve epochs of history, an honest agent 30,000 once. Weakness: newcomers wait twelve epochs for full rights, a cold start favouring incumbents.
